definitions.explanation: the distribution of water through pipes and infrastructure to homes and facilities

examples.japanese: {配水|はいすい}{管|かん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{古|ふる}く→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦なっている→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The water distribution pipes are getting old.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{配水|はいすい}⟦システム→システム：08428_shisutemu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{損傷|そんしょう}→損傷：21079_sonshou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The water distribution system was damaged by the earthquake.

examples.japanese: ⟦{市|し}→市：01599_shi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{老朽化|ろうきゅうか}→老朽化：07646_roukyuuka⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧{配水|はいすい}⟦{施設|しせつ}→施設：02503_shisetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{更新|こうしん}→更新：04765_koushin⟧⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}している→計画する：20998_keikakusuru⟧。
examples.english: The city is planning renovation work on the aging water distribution facilities.

notes:
Refers to the process and infrastructure of distributing clean water to homes and buildings. This is the supply side of the water system — getting water from treatment plants to consumers.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {配水|はいすい}{管|かん}: water distribution pipe
- {配水|はいすい}{池|ち}: distribution reservoir
- {配水|はいすい}⟦{施設|しせつ}→施設：02503_shisetsu⟧: water distribution facility
- {配水|はいすい}⟦{量|りょう}→量：03799_ryou⟧: volume of water distributed

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{排水|はいすい}→排水：11104_haisui⟧: drainage — same pronunciation but opposite direction; removing used water. Written with {排|はい} (expel) instead of {配|はい} (distribute)
- ⟦{給水|きゅうすい}→給水：15031_kyuusui⟧: water supply — focuses on providing water to a specific point, often temporary (e.g., emergency water supply)
- ⟦{上水|じょうすい}→上水：20521_jousui⟧: clean water/tap water — the water itself rather than the distribution process
- ⟦{水道|すいどう}→水道：01058_suidou⟧: water service/waterworks — the broader system including pipes, treatment, and billing
